items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Interviewer mentions Jimmy Harrison; Interviewee responds 'Very little' regarding influence and later discusses Louis Armstrong's general effect, but never claims a personal connection or direct interaction with Jimmy Harrison.

ctx.x: You mean Geechee Robison? I mean Geechee Robison. I'm trying to write. That's a New York drama pop. I'm trying to write at the same time. Yeah, but here's the thing about Geechee. Geechee didn't have a set style. He didn't copy anyone, but he did try to play solos in Tricky Sam style with Dewey. But he also played his own solos.
Yeah, well if anything, you know, to me it sounds like he listened to maybe a Jimmy Harrison song.
